english.title: Supervisor - holder of prov licence fail give veh owner name / address to PC - accident in public place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe was supervising **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, while driving a motor vehicle, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) at a time when

(A)_[an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(B)_[an offence was suspected of having been committed by the said licence holder in relation to the use of the vehicle]_

on a public place namely **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), on being required by a constable failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For the comparable offence in relation to accident/suspected offence on a road see H55.
(ii) This offence wording does not relate to invalid carriages.
(iii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) This offence was extended to include 'other public place' by the The Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations 2000 - S.I. 726/2000 refers.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was suspected of supervising **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, who was driving **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) at a time when

(B)_[an offence was suspected of having been committed by **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..) in relation to the use of the vehicle]_

on **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Goruchwyliwr deilydd trwydded dros dro yn methu rhoi enw/cyfeiriad y perchennog i heddwas - damwain mewn man cyhoeddus

Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn goruchwylio **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVER..), deilydd trwydded dros dro, a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan

(A)_[ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
